goals: Provide a server-authoritative trowel that draws eligible building materials by quantity from the actual offhand shulker and delegates placement through the resolved BlockItem's normal placement path.
Keep Full Block, Slab, Stair, and Wall Trowel-owned while discovering extended modes from the unified BGE catalog without a separate Nibaru artifact or dependency.

Preserve saved/network identities 0 through 6 while separating selector order from persistence, using exact resolved geometry items, and preserving material identity, consumption, sound, state, and fail-closed semantics.
scope: Canonical C9 dependency-aligned source for Minecraft 26.2 Fabric, retaining accepted behavior and stable IDs 0 through 6 for Full Block, Slab, Stair, Wall, Vertical Slab, Step, and Layer, with Corner ID 7 and Quarter Column ID 8.

The narrow CNM 2.0.7 overlay and input seam plus exact unified BGE C57 catalog resolution, with selector order Full Block, Slab, Stair, Wall, Vertical Slab, Step, Corner, Quarter Column, Layer independent from saved/network identity.

Use each descriptor's actual resolved geometry item for display and normal BlockItem placement, retain selected identity when a material geometry is unavailable, and admit future BGE catalog descriptors without a new hard-coded Trowel geometry name.
The private runnable-asset boundary in which only the separately authorized Jake's Build Tools sprite is added to externally retained, non-redistributable private artifacts.

exclusions: Protected Jake's Build Tools bytes, the authorized sprite, exact private C9/Private Canary 8 and predecessor C8 candidates, and accepted/rollback private C5 runnable JAR are not tracked or redistributed.
CNM and unified BGE remain external dependency owners; this project does not bundle them or replace their canonical material and geometry systems.
Registry-name parsing, parallel family tables, variant collapsing, and unrelated block mutation behavior.
Promotion of runtime-untested C9, mutation of accepted C5 provenance, unrelated runtime-slot changes, and protected gameplay-profile access.
